spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (पथति)
To go, to move.
r. 10th cl. (पथयति)
To throw, to cast, to despatch or send;
(इ,) पथि r. 1st and 10th cls. (पन्थति पन्थयति)
To go, to proceed, to travel.

m. (-थः)
A road.
E.
पथ to go, aff. अच्.

m. (-थः)
1 The sun.
2 Fire.
n. (-थं)
Water.
E.
पा to drink, and थक् aff.; the more usual form however is पीथ.

mfn. (-थन्-थन्ती-थत्)
Going, travelling.
m. (-थन्)
A road.
E.
पथ to go, शतृ aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-की-कं)
Knowing or going on a road.
m. (-कः)
1 A traveller, a way-farer.
2 A guide, one who knows the way.
E.
पथिन् a road, वुन् or ष्कन् aff.

f. (-तिः)
A line or range of travellers, a cafileh, a caravan.
E.
पथिक a traveller, सन्तति a range; also with संहति assemblage, पथिकसंहति.

m. (-मः)
A sort of Khayar, (Mimosa alba.)
E.
पथिन् a road, and द्रुम a tree.

m. (-पन्था)
1 A road, a way.
2 Sect, doctrine, path in morals or religion.
3 A division of hell.
E.
पथ to go, इन् Uṇādi aff.; the noun is irregularly inflected.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Acquainted with roads.
E.
पथिन्, and प्रज्ञ who knows.

m. (-लः)
A traveller, a way-farer. पथिन् a road, इलच् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
1 A fowler, a bird-catcher.
2 A porter, a burthen-carrier.
E.
पथिन् a road, and वाहक who bears.

mfn. (-थ्यः-थ्या-थ्यं)
Proper, fit, suitable, agreeing with, but applied chiefly medically, with respect to diet, regimen, &c.
mf. (-थ्यः-थ्या)
Yellow Myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)
n. (-थ्यं)
Sea salt.
E.
पथ to go, यत् aff.

n. (-थ्यं)
The class of things that are considered beneficial or hurtful in disease.
E.
पथ्य, and अपथ्य improper.

mfn. (-शी-शिनी-शि)
Eating wholesome things.
E.
पथ्य, and आशिन् who eats.

n. (-थः)
Water.
E.
पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and थुक् augment.

m. (-थिः)
1 The sea.
2 The eye.
n. (-थि)
A blotch, a scab.
E.
पा to drink, Uṇādi aff. इसि, and थुक augment.

n. (-यं)
1 Provender, or provisions, &c. for a journey.
2 The sign Virgo.
E.
पथिन् road, aff. ढञ्.

n. (-जं)
A lotus.
E.
पाथस्, and ज produced.

m. (-दः)
A cloud.
E.
पाथस् water, दा to give, aff. क.

m. (-रः)
A cloud.
E.
पाथस् water, धर having.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
पाथस् water, and धा to have, aff. कि.

m. (-धिः)
The ocean.
E.
पाथस् water, and निधि receptacle.
